name: Furnace
summary: Heats and circulates air through the home's ductwork.
education: A furnace pulls return air across a heat exchanger and sends it back through the ducts. Routine filter changes and an annual professional inspection extend its life and protect against carbon-monoxide leaks from a cracked heat exchanger.

questions.prompt: When was it last professionally serviced?

suggested_photos.prompt: Nameplate with model and serial number
Where the filter goes (capture the size)

maintenance.why: A clogged filter strains the blower, reduces efficiency, and can overheat the unit.

maintenance.cadence_text: Once a year, ideally in fall before heating season
maintenance.why: Catches cracked heat exchangers, weak ignitors, and clogged burners before failure.
